entry_contents.paragraph_content: So you might be wondering why I have not made a lot of posts or shared any, and why I have not made any music for a long while.

To begin with, there have been a lot of things happening in the background that are more than music or being in the persona of Koguma Rin. First, I am constantly in development for my thesis, making me shift my paradigm from music to programming and vice versa. Not only about my paradigm about what I do, but also on how I do certain stuff, as well as how excited I am about producing my first album, it almost felt like I am pushing myself too hard, leading to frequent burnouts.

I am very sorry that I have been inactive for a while. I'll try to come back soon and keep in touch with everyone. Furthermore, now that I have had the chance to switch systems from Windows to Mac, I want to experiment with new styles of music.
Anyways, that's it from me for now. I might be more active when Christmas comes. Come join my Discord sometime so we can keep in touch!
well thanks for taking your time reading this post XD
December 1, 2025.

Hello to the listeners of Koguma Rin, I know the anticipation and the expectations that you all have been building for my very first album titled, "Rin's Silly Tunes." I myself have been excited about writing and producing the additional tracks other than the EPs, however, with the sign of it being already delayed back in July following unforseen events, this project is better put to rest.

The hardware where I've been writing the album finally made its last run last week. Since the SSDs where my project files, audio samples, and plugins are stored are internal, this will be harder for me to retrieve.

I sincerly apologise for the expectation you might have had before this event, and also a lesson to create file backups now and then. Looking forward, I also plan on doing something new on the side, as a new beginning on pushing bounds in music production. I'Il see you sometime soon.
Koguma Rin / KOGS Label
Mass mention ahead once again!~

As a part of Koguma Rin's 1.5 Anniversary, I just wanted to give a New Year's message for all of the events that happened this year. Last year, it was a couple of friends; now there are more. I consider them as friends who really supported me throughout the months of my service~

To Poru Romi, Akunawa Kes, and Reneua Kurosaki, I still admire your works as much this year, even though we do not interact as much. Keep on creating arts and music next. I look forward to seeing them.

To Ruri Yoshinova, Kinoshita Kaede, Jasneer Mondejar Payabyab, Bocchi Waif, Luna Senchi, Naoyuki Ishizaki, Jane Cerys, Llennsie San, Ruby Liessfeldt, Fuyuhime Akito, Shino Yoruzeki, thank you for keeping tabs and sticking with me this year, even though I am so bad at playing Left 4 Dead 2 XDDDDD
And to old friends, Kairo Sicarion, Ryn Auvergne, Brian Raver Cajigal, we might not have interacted that much this year, but I hope you're alright against your silent battles.
See you all in 2026! Happy New Year! !
- Koguma Rin

I've always wanted to do a name change since I wanted to detach a bit of Kogs from me. Of course having this name is an honor, though it has been iconic enough that it is something that I cannot really take off from me completely. As a result, I just immortalised Kogs as a nod to "Cogs and Gears Factory" server name.

How did I even come up with "Koguma Rin"? Well it is a nod to the two Slice of Life (SOL) anime references: Super Cub and Yuru Camp, respectively; Koguma, and Shima Rin. SOL animes I think are the best of genres out there.

I still love being called Kogs or Koguma Rin. It is who I am after all, that started since 2024. But of course I want to move on and change my title, just to have a change of pace at the internet life.
